name: California
summary: Generative AI providers serving 1M+ California users must offer a free public AI-detection tool, embed both visible and hidden provenance markers in generated content, and disclose when content is AI-generated on user request.

disclosure.headline: AI-generated content — California SB 942 notice
disclosure.body: Some content on this page may be generated or modified by an artificial intelligence system. Under California SB 942 you may request provenance information for any AI-generated material and use the public AI-detection tool below to verify content origin.
